title: Transparent film (alpha background)
text: When on, the world background is left out of the final image and those pixels get zero alpha, so the render has a transparent background for compositing over other footage.

title: Frame rate
text: Frames per second used for playback and animation timing of the scene.

title: Motion blur
text: Turns on blur of moving objects and cameras across the shutter interval of each frame.

title: Motion blur shutter
text: How long the virtual shutter stays open, in frames. Longer values give stronger motion blur.

title: Cycles render samples
text: Number of path tracing samples per pixel for final Cycles renders. More samples mean less noise and longer render times.

title: EEVEE render samples
text: Number of temporal anti-aliasing samples EEVEE accumulates per pixel for final renders. More samples smooth edges, soft shadows and noise.

title: View transform (colour management)
text: Maps scene-linear light to display colour. AgX handles bright highlights gracefully; Standard applies no tone mapping.

title: Look (contrast preset)
signature: look: enum, e.g. 'None', 'AgX - Punchy', 'AgX - High Contrast'
text: A contrast or grading preset applied on top of the view transform.

title: Exposure
text: Brightens or darkens the whole image in stops before the view transform, like changing camera exposure.

title: Gamma
text: Extra gamma correction applied after the view transform.

title: Output width
text: Horizontal pixel count of the rendered image. Set with render.set_resolution.

title: Output height
text: Vertical pixel count of the rendered image. Set with render.set_resolution.

title: Render engine
text: Which renderer produces the image. Set with render.set_engine.

title: Camera focal length
signature: lens: float in [1, inf], millimetres, default 50
text: Focal length of a perspective camera. Longer lenses narrow the field of view and flatten perspective. Set with camera.set_lens.

title: Depth of field
text: Turns on focus blur for objects nearer or farther than the focus distance. Configure through the camera tools (discover camera.).

title: Aperture f-stop
text: Lower f-stop values give a shallower depth of field and stronger background blur.

title: Light power
signature: energy: float, watts for point, spot and area lights
text: Brightness of a light. Use the light tools (light.add with a rig) rather than setting it directly.

title: Object location
text: Position of an object in world space for unparented objects. Set when adding objects or cameras.

title: Object scale
text: Per-axis size multiplier of an object.

title: World background colour
text: Flat background colour of the world when it has no node tree. For an image with no background at all, use film transparency instead.
